justification: Lets the flood planning answer use council maps that cover only studied areas, without false no answers elsewhere. Not Critical: only adds yes answers and in-study no answers. Not Minor: served flood answers change once the 3 maps load.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: Fails if a PARTIAL map makes a whole council covered, or a partial council gives no outside its study area.
falsifiable_check.external_authority: Vetted council ArcGIS items 2026-10-28; dry runs read 306/5/25/15 shapes from the live services.
falsifiable_check.observed_red: The new tests describe behaviour absent before: any planning row made the whole council covered.

pre_impl.existing_data: spatial_overlays flood: 33 values, 72 councils; spatial_overlays_coverage says 12 (stale, not used).
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: The old lookup said False whenever the table had any flood row, and True for PMF and non-flood rows.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: One new producer module; the flood tool's own flood queries removed (producer lint 4->2 in flood_truth).
pre_impl.external_source_error: Spatial Services outage or DB error -> None with reason, never no.

functions.name: _covered_councils
functions.what: Excludes PARTIAL_ maps from whole-council coverage.
functions.input: an open database cursor on spatial_overlays
functions.output: set of councils with full flood planning maps
functions.if_none: Errors propagate to the caller, which returns None.

functions.name: _inside_study_area
functions.what: Is the point inside a loaded study-area outline.
functions.output: true when the point is inside an outline
functions.if_none: No outline rows means false, so not known.

break_it.scenario: Address in Bellingen outside the river study area
break_it.what_happens: Answer stays not known, never a false no

break_it.scenario: Address in Coffs Harbour inside a mapped flood planning area
break_it.what_happens: Answer is yes from the partial map

break_it.scenario: A PARTIAL map row is mistaken for a full council map
break_it.how: NOT LIKE 'PARTIAL_%' in the covered query

gaps: Coffs Harbour and Cessnock have no study-area outline yet (yes only)
Loads run only after this deploys

post_merge.action: After deploy: run ingest_flood_studies.py for bellingen_fpa, bellingen_coverage, coffs_fpa, cessnock_1pct (inserts only; rollback = DELETE WHERE instrument_key LIKE 'PARTIAL_%')
post_merge.manual_verify: /pipeline/flood-planning for a Bellingen study-area point says yes or no; outside says not known

real_layer_exempt.services/flood_planning.py: SQL checked by live dry runs and the post-merge load check.
